headlines.title_en: Morning wrap-up on Aug 13: ChiNext up 1.61% at midday; pharma and computing power concept stocks rally broadly
headlines.summary_en: 1. The market opened high and fluctuated in the morning, with both the ChiNext and STAR indices up over 1%. Pharmaceutical stocks remained active, with Boji Medical, Wanbang Pharma, Longshenrongfa and others hitting limit-up. Computing power leasing concept stocks rallied collectively, with Chengdi Xiangjiang hitting 3 consecutive limit-ups, and Li'ang Technology, Qunxing Toys and others hitting limit-up. Food and beverage sector became active again, with Royal Group and Yiming Food both hitting 4 consecutive limit-ups. Super-node concept surged, with Gongjin Electronics hitting limit-up. More stocks fell than rose, with over 3,000 stocks in the red across Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets, and turnover reached 1.6 trillion yuan in the morning session. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.42%, Shenzhen Component rose 0.73%, and ChiNext rose 1.61%. 2. In terms of sectors, pharmaceutical/healthcare, computing power leasing, computing power hardware, and semiconductors led gains; precious metals, oil & gas, education, and real estate led losses. 3. Across the two markets, 2,186 stocks rose, with 56 hitting limit-up; 2,879 fell, with none hitting limit-down.

headlines.title_en: Morning news roundup
headlines.summary_en: ChiNext Index rose 1.61% in the morning, with pharmaceutical and computing power concept stocks gaining collectively. Hang Seng Index rose 0.1% in the morning, Hang Seng Tech Index up 0.3%, Hang Seng Biotech Index up 2.6%, MINIMAX and Hua Hong Semiconductor both up over 5%. AI trading rebounded, South Korean stocks returned to a technical bull market, rising nearly 5% intraday, with Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix both up over 4%. The Bank of Korea made its first gold-related investment in 13 years in Q2. Zhipu led 33 Chinese stocks selected into the MSCI index, with overseas passive funds set to flood in at month-end. Lenovo Group Q1 revenue grew 43%, adjusted net profit rose 176% year-on-year.

headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.summary_en: [UK Q2 GDP grew 0.4% quarter-on-quarter, slowing from the previous quarter] On Aug 13, the UK Office for National Statistics reported that real GDP grew 0.4% quarter-on-quarter in Q2 2026, slowing from 0.6% growth in Q1. Q2 growth was mainly driven by the services sector, with services output up 0.5%, construction up 0.3%, and industrial output flat.

headlines.title_zh: 香港商业地产投资增速跑赢亚太其他市场
headlines.summary_zh: 据仲量联行数据，香港商业地产投资第二季度增长逾一倍，达到31亿美元，零售和写字楼交易强劲增长及低基数效应使其成为亚太地区增长最快的投资市场。同比增长129%，超过了新加坡等其他表现最佳的市场。

headlines.title: 联想AI服务器储备订单大增
headlines.summary: 联想集团(00992.HK)港交所披露2026/27财年第一财季业绩显示，AI服务器储备订单从上一财季的1400亿元，大幅提高至3600亿元人民币。第一财季联想集团AI相关业务收入同比增长60%，达到634亿元人民币，创历史新高，占集团整体营收约35%；AI服务收入同比增长141%。

headlines.title_en: Lenovo AI server order backlog rises sharply
headlines.summary_en: Lenovo Group (00992.HK) disclosed Q1 FY2026/27 results via the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, showing AI server backlog orders surged from RMB 140 billion in the prior quarter to RMB 360 billion. In Q1, Lenovo's AI-related revenue rose 60% year-on-year to RMB 63.4 billion, a record high, accounting for about 35% of total revenue; AI services revenue rose 141% year-on-year.
